s0401.literal: Monks were ordered to perform a great land-and-water assembly for seven days and nights.
s0401.idiomatic: Monks were ordered to perform a great land-and-water assembly for seven days and nights.

s0402.literal: On guimao day Jupiter transgressed Well.
s0402.idiomatic: On guimao day Jupiter transgressed Well.

s0403.literal: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Hooked Clasp.
s0403.idiomatic: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Hooked Clasp.

s0404.literal: A joint sacrifice to the Supreme Ruler of August Heaven and August Earth was held at the southern suburb; Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat Dalaqan Halaqsun was dispatched to preside over the rites.
s0404.idiomatic: A joint sacrifice to the Supreme Ruler of August Heaven and August Earth was held at the southern suburb; left chancellor of the central secretariat Dalaqan Halaqsun was dispatched to preside over the rites.

s0405.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the yichou new moon, Venus transgressed Eastern Well.
s0405.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yichou new moon, Venus transgressed Eastern Well.

s0406.literal: On dingmao day an edict granted a partial amnesty to the various barbarian tribes of Yunnan;
s0406.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict granted a partial amnesty to the various barbarian tribes of Yunnan;

s0407.literal: three hundred shi of grain from the Tongzhou granary were issued to relieve impoverished commoners;
s0407.idiomatic: 300 shi of grain from the Tongzhou granary were issued to relieve impoverished commoners;

s0408.literal: thirty-eight prisoners of lighter and heavier offenses were released, each granted five ingots of notes.
s0408.idiomatic: 38 prisoners of lighter and heavier offenses were released, each granted five ingots of notes.

s0409.literal: On yihai day the southern river at Yongqing County was dredged.
s0409.idiomatic: On yihai day the southern river at Yongqing County was dredged.

s0410.literal: On wuyin day the moon transgressed Heart.
s0410.idiomatic: On wuyin day the moon transgressed Heart.

s0411.literal: On gengchen day Shangdu suffered great flooding and the people were hungry; ten thousand shi of grain was sold at reduced prices for relief.
s0411.idiomatic: On gengchen day Shangdu suffered great flooding and the people were hungry; 10,000 shi of grain was sold at reduced prices for relief.

s0412.literal: On wuzi day the river embankment at Shijing Shan on the upper Lu River was repaired.
s0412.idiomatic: On wuzi day the river embankment at Shijing Shan on the upper Lu River was repaired.

s0414.literal: The imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.
s0414.idiomatic: The imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.

s0415.literal: On gengyin day Venus transgressed Ghost.
s0415.idiomatic: On gengyin day Venus transgressed Ghost.

s0416.literal: Locusts afflicted Zhending, Daming, Hejian, and other routes.
s0416.idiomatic: Locusts afflicted Zhending, Daming, Hejian, and other routes.

s0417.literal: Fifth month, on yisi day: land was granted to impoverished Han army households — one qing to those with five adult males, two qing to those with four, three qing to those with three; the orphaned, widowed, and solitary were sustained for six years; those who had fled and scattered were summoned and urged to return to their occupations.
s0417.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yisi day, land was granted to impoverished Han army households — one qing to households with five adult males, two qing to those with four, three qing to those with three; the orphaned, widowed, and solitary were sustained for six years; those who had fled and scattered were summoned and urged to return to their occupations.

s0418.literal: On wushen day fire destroyed the sleeping hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0418.idiomatic: On wushen day fire destroyed the sleeping hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0419.literal: On guichou day routed troops from Karakorum ordered to campaign against Yunnan were banished; those wounded in battle and returned, and those once exempted by order of the Prince of Jin or Prince Yaomuhu'er, were not sent.
s0419.idiomatic: On guichou day routed troops from Karakorum ordered to campaign against Yunnan were banished; those wounded in battle and returned, and those once exempted by order of the Prince of Jin or Prince Yaomuhu'er, were not sent.

s0420.literal: On dingsi day Fuzhou Route suffered famine; relief was granted with fourteen thousand seven hundred shi of grain.
s0420.idiomatic: On dingsi day Fuzhou Route suffered famine; relief was granted with 14,700 shi of grain.

s0421.literal: Jinan Route suffered great flooding; Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered locusts; Guide, Xuzhou, and Pizhou suffered flooding.
s0421.idiomatic: Jinan Route suffered great flooding; Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered locusts; Guide, Xuzhou, and Pizhou suffered flooding.

s0422.literal: Sixth month, on the guihai new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0422.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the guihai new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0423.literal: The Bureau of Astronomy failed in calendar calculation; the central secretariat was ordered to deliberate on punishments and report.
s0423.idiomatic: The Bureau of Astronomy failed in calendar calculation; the central secretariat was ordered to deliberate on punishments and report.

s0424.literal: Saturn transgressed the Western Wall Upper General of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0424.idiomatic: Saturn transgressed the Western Wall Upper General of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0425.literal: On jiazi day the Temple of the Sage was built at the capital.
s0425.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Temple of the Sage was built at the capital.

s0426.literal: On xinwei day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0426.idiomatic: On xinwei day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0427.literal: On yihai day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.
s0427.idiomatic: On yihai day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.

s0428.literal: The kingdom of Annam presented two trained elephants and cinnabar as tribute.
s0428.idiomatic: The kingdom of Annam presented two trained elephants and cinnabar as tribute.

s0429.literal: On jiashen day more than forty-five thousand eight hundred ingots of notes were granted to the departments of princes Hedasun, Toghan, Tolai Temür, Boyalun, and Wanzhe.
s0429.idiomatic: On jiashen day more than 45,800 ingots of notes were granted to the departments of princes Hedasun, Toghan, Tolai Temür, Boyalun, and Wanzhe.

s0430.literal: Huzhou, Jiaxing, Hangzhou, Guangde, Raozhou, Taiping, Wuzhou, Qingyuan, Shaoxing, Ningguo, and other routes suffered famine; more than two hundred fifty-one thousand shi of grain was issued for relief.
s0430.idiomatic: Huzhou, Jiaxing, Hangzhou, Guangde, Raozhou, Taiping, Wuzhou, Qingyuan, Shaoxing, Ningguo, and other routes suffered famine; more than 251,000 shi of grain was issued for relief.

s0431.literal: Datong Route and Ninghai Prefecture also suffered famine; sixteen thousand shi of grain was issued for relief.
s0431.idiomatic: Datong Route and Ninghai Prefecture also suffered famine; 16,000 shi of grain was issued for relief.

s0433.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the guisi new moon, Mars, Saturn, and Mercury gathered at Well.
s0433.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guisi new moon, Mars, Saturn, and Mercury gathered at Well.

s0434.literal: On gengzi day the moon transgressed Heart.
s0434.idiomatic: On gengzi day the moon transgressed Heart.

s0435.literal: On jiyou day three native chieftains of Yiqibuxie abandoned their homes and came to submit; they were granted gold and silver tallies and clothing.
s0435.idiomatic: On jiyou day three native chieftains of Yiqibuxie abandoned their homes and came to submit; they were granted gold and silver tallies and clothing.

s0436.literal: On wuwu day the moon transgressed Mars.
s0436.idiomatic: On wuwu day the moon transgressed Mars.

s0437.literal: On xinyou day more than forty-three thousand nine hundred ingots of notes were granted to princes Babai, Totoqai, Yezhili, Yemiegan, and others.
s0437.idiomatic: On xinyou day more than 43,900 ingots of notes were granted to princes Babai, Totoqai, Yezhili, Yemiegan, and others.

s0438.literal: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat associate administrative commissioner Hududding was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.
s0438.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat associate administrative commissioner Hududding was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0439.literal: The people of Jiankang suffered famine; twenty thousand shi of rice was issued for relief.
s0439.idiomatic: The people of Jiankang suffered famine; 20,000 shi of rice was issued for relief.

s0440.literal: Locusts afflicted the various counties of Dadu as well as Zhenjiang, Anfeng, and Hao Prefectures; Shunde suffered flooding.
s0440.idiomatic: Locusts afflicted the various counties of Dadu as well as Zhenjiang, Anfeng, and Hao Prefectures; Shunde suffered flooding.

s0441.literal: Eighth month, on jiazi day an edict directed that for all marriage and land-field documents under the various offices, when amnesties were granted they should be reviewed in accordance with precedent.
s0441.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiazi day, an edict directed that for all marriage and land-field documents under the various offices, when amnesties were granted they should be reviewed in accordance with precedent.

s0442.literal: On yichou day Mars transgressed Jupiter.
s0442.idiomatic: On yichou day Mars transgressed Jupiter.

s0443.literal: On jisi day Mars transgressed Ghost.
s0443.idiomatic: On jisi day Mars transgressed Ghost.

s0444.literal: On xinsi day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.
s0444.idiomatic: On xinsi day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

s0445.literal: On renwu day Venus transgressed Chariot.
s0445.idiomatic: On renwu day Venus transgressed Chariot.

s0446.literal: Ninth month, on yiwei day Ayachi and Sahantu were dispatched to audit the annual revenue of the Chenghai colony fields; from then on pacification commission officials and Alatai were to jointly administer them.
s0446.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiwei day, Ayachi and Sahantu were dispatched to audit the annual revenue of the Chenghai colony fields; from then on pacification commission officials and Alatai were to jointly administer them.

s0447.literal: On jiawu day sixty thousand ingots of notes were granted to the department of Prince Ulus Buqa.
s0447.idiomatic: On jiawu day 60,000 ingots of notes were granted to the department of Prince Ulus Buqa.

s0448.literal: On bingwu day Mars transgressed Chariot.
s0448.idiomatic: On bingwu day Mars transgressed Chariot.

s0449.literal: On dingwei day central secretariat officials said: "Luoli and others harass the people; they should be sentenced and dispatched according to precedent to garrison-farming posts.
s0449.idiomatic: On dingwei day central secretariat officials said, "Luoli and others harass the people; they should be sentenced and dispatched according to precedent to garrison-farming posts.

s0451.literal: More than eighty-six thousand three hundred ingots of notes were granted to princes Basar and others.
s0451.idiomatic: More than 86,300 ingots of notes were granted to princes Basar and others.

s0452.literal: On jiyou day the people of Longxing spread a rumor that boys and girls were being registered for conscription, to the point that some killed their own children; an order was issued to execute the three ringleaders.
s0452.idiomatic: On jiyou day the people of Longxing spread a rumor that boys and girls were being registered for conscription, to the point that some killed their own children; an order was issued to execute the three ringleaders.

s0453.literal: On guichou day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0453.idiomatic: On guichou day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0454.literal: On dingsi day Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer.
s0454.idiomatic: On dingsi day Venus transgressed the Right Enforcer.

s0455.literal: Five thousand eight hundred forty ingots of notes were granted to princes Niekudie'er and others.
s0455.idiomatic: 5,840 ingots of notes were granted to princes Niekudie'er and others.

s0456.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiazi day the Zhedong Pacification Commission was renamed the Pacification Commission Commander-in-Chief Headquarters, its seat moved to Qingyuan, to guard and suppress the sea routes.
s0456.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi day, the Zhedong pacification commission was renamed the pacification commission commander-in-chief headquarters, its seat moved to Qingyuan, to guard and suppress the sea routes.

s0457.literal: Colony fields were established at Huanghualing in Datong Route.
s0457.idiomatic: Colony fields were established at Huanghualing in Datong Route.

s0458.literal: The Army Stores Office was abolished; the Colony Stores Military-Civilian Chief Ten-Thousand-Household Office was established with six officials, and Army Stores Office pacification commissioner Fahur al-Din continued to oversee it.
s0458.idiomatic: The army stores office was abolished; the colony stores military-civilian chief ten-thousand-household office was established with six officials, and army stores office pacification commissioner Fahur al-Din continued to oversee it.

s0459.literal: A southern subject Lin Dulin reported that Zhexi surveillance commissioner Zhang Gui possessed banned books and calculated the Emperor's Five Elements; Jiang-Zhe transport commissioner Hezhi also said Gui obstructed the salt law; provincial and censorate officials were ordered jointly to interrogate the case.
s0459.idiomatic: A southern subject Lin Dulin reported that Zhexi surveillance commissioner Zhang Gui possessed banned books and calculated the Emperor's Five Elements; Jiang-Zhe transport commissioner Hezhi also said Gui obstructed the salt law; provincial and censorate officials were ordered jointly to interrogate the case.

s0460.literal: On bingzi day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
s0460.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

s0461.literal: On renwu day Mars transgressed the Western Wall Upper General of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0461.idiomatic: On renwu day Mars transgressed the Western Wall Upper General of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0462.literal: Bin, Di, Tai'an, and Gaotang prefectures in Jinan suffered continuous rain; rice prices soared and many commoners fled; grain was issued for relief, and thirty thousand ingots of notes were also granted.
s0462.idiomatic: Bin, Di, Tai'an, and Gaotang prefectures in Jinan suffered continuous rain; rice prices soared and many commoners fled; grain was issued for relief, and 30,000 ingots of notes were also granted.

s0463.literal: Eleventh month, on xinmao day Saturn transgressed the Left Enforcer.
s0463.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, Saturn transgressed the Left Enforcer.

s0464.literal: On jiawu day Liu Guojie's vice-commander Song Guang led troops to inflict a great defeat on She Jie; he was granted two suits of clothing and also invested with a gold tally.
s0464.idiomatic: On jiawu day Liu Guojie's vice-commander Song Guang led troops to inflict a great defeat on She Jie; he was granted two suits of clothing and also invested with a gold tally.

s0465.literal: On yiwei day Mercury transgressed Room.
s0465.idiomatic: On yiwei day Mercury transgressed Room.

s0466.literal: On guimao day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.
s0466.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

s0467.literal: On jiyou day the moon transgressed Chariot.
s0467.idiomatic: On jiyou day the moon transgressed Chariot.

s0468.literal: On gengxu day brewing liquor was forbidden to Karakorum troops; only Prince of Anxi Ananda, princes Hulachu, Totoq, Babusha, Yezhili, imperial son-in-law Manzitai, Hongjiliedai, and Yanligan were permitted to brew.
s0468.idiomatic: On gengxu day brewing liquor was forbidden to Karakorum troops; only Prince of Anxi Ananda, princes Hulachu, Totoq, Babusha, Yezhili, imperial son-in-law Manzitai, Hongjiliedai, and Yanligan were permitted to brew.

s0469.literal: On xinhai day associate manager of the Privy Council Hede was made manager of the Privy Council.
s0469.idiomatic: On xinhai day associate manager of the privy council Hede was made manager of the privy council.

s0470.literal: An edict directed that for all temples and monasteries in Jiangnan, additional civilian fields registered and land donated by commoners were all to pay rent and perform corvée service.
s0470.idiomatic: An edict directed that for all temples and monasteries in Jiangnan, additional civilian fields registered and land donated by commoners were all to pay rent and perform corvée service.

s0471.literal: On wuwu day the skilled archers' army of Hexi and Ningxia was registered under Prince Amuge, and the Ganzhou army under Prince Chubor.
s0471.idiomatic: On wuwu day the skilled archers' army of Hexi and Ningxia was registered under Prince Amuge, and the Ganzhou army under Prince Chubor.

s0472.literal: On jiwei day an edict declared that postal couriers who took circuitous routes were to be punished.
s0472.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict declared that postal couriers who took circuitous routes were to be punished.

s0473.literal: Twelfth month, on the gengshen new moon, Mars transgressed Saturn.
s0473.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengshen new moon, Mars transgressed Saturn.

s0474.literal: On xinyou day censorate officials said: "Since the first year of Dade there have repeatedly been celestial anomalies and wind-and-water disasters, and the people lack food.
s0474.idiomatic: On xinyou day censorate officials said, "Since the first year of Dade there have repeatedly been celestial anomalies and wind-and-water disasters, and the people lack food.

s0475.literal: Your Majesty's reverence for Heaven and love for the people have been without limit; it is right that disasters should be turned into blessings;
s0475.idiomatic: Your Majesty's reverence for Heaven and love for the people have been without limit; it is right that disasters should be turned into blessings;

s0476.literal: yet this year spring frost destroyed the wheat, autumn rains damaged the crops, and in the fifth month the Imperial Ancestral Temple suffered fire — especially grave matters in all ages.
s0476.idiomatic: yet this year spring frost destroyed the wheat, autumn rains damaged the crops, and in the fifth month the Imperial Ancestral Temple suffered fire — especially grave matters in all ages.

s0477.literal: We reflect that perhaps those bearing Your Majesty's heavy responsibilities have been unable to carry out the sacred will, leading to this.
s0477.idiomatic: We reflect that perhaps those bearing Your Majesty's heavy responsibilities have been unable to carry out the sacred will, leading to this.

s0478.literal: If there is no renewal, later it will be hard to set right.
s0478.idiomatic: If there is no renewal, later it will be hard to set right.

s0479.literal: We request that the central secretariat and aged ministers versed in principles of governance jointly plan remedies.
s0479.idiomatic: We request that the central secretariat and aged ministers versed in principles of governance jointly plan remedies.

s0480.literal: " They further requested prohibition of brewing in the various routes, remission and reduction of corvée levies and taxes, and relief for hungry commoners.
s0480.idiomatic: They further requested prohibition of brewing in the various routes, remission and reduction of corvée levies and taxes, and relief for hungry commoners.

s0481.literal: The Emperor commended and accepted all this, and ordered central secretariat officials to deliberate on implementing it.
s0481.idiomatic: The Emperor commended and accepted all this, and ordered central secretariat officials to deliberate on implementing it.

s0483.literal: On wuchen day it shook again.
s0483.idiomatic: On wuchen day it shook again.

s0484.literal: On jiazi day Yuan Shunyi of Heng Prefecture and others incited and gathered more than two thousand men to raid Chen Prefecture; the Hunan pacification commission mobilized troops to suppress them, captured Shunyi and the rest of the band, and ordered execution of the three chief conspirators; the remainder were assigned to colony fields at Hongze and Shaobo; those coerced were summoned and urged to return to their occupations.
s0484.idiomatic: On jiazi day Yuan Shunyi of Heng Prefecture and others incited and gathered more than 2,000 men to raid Chen Prefecture; the Hunan pacification commission mobilized troops to suppress them, captured Shunyi and the rest of the band, and ordered execution of the three chief conspirators; the remainder were assigned to colony fields at Hongze and Shaobo; those coerced were summoned and urged to return to their occupations.

s0485.literal: On yichou day Jupiter transgressed Ghost.
s0485.idiomatic: On yichou day Jupiter transgressed Ghost.

s0486.literal: On yihai day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0486.idiomatic: On yihai day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0487.literal: On bingzi day Liu Guojie and Yesian Hududu came to present news of victory over She Jie, Luogui, and others.
s0487.idiomatic: On bingzi day Liu Guojie and Yesian Hududu came to present news of victory over She Jie, Luogui, and others.

s0488.literal: On gengchen day Mars transgressed the eastern rampart upper chancellor of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0488.idiomatic: On gengchen day Mars transgressed the eastern rampart upper chancellor of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0489.literal: The central secretariat was ordered to revise the criminal statutes on selling free persons by fraud.
s0489.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered to revise the criminal statutes on selling free persons by fraud.

s0490.literal: On guiwei day the moon transgressed Room.
s0490.idiomatic: On guiwei day the moon transgressed Room.

s0491.literal: Baoding and other routes suffered famine; ten thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
s0491.idiomatic: Baoding and other routes suffered famine; 10,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

s0492.literal: That year, three persons were sentenced to death.
s0492.idiomatic: That year, three persons were sentenced to death.
